tools.name: smartsupp_list_agents
tools.description: List the support agents of the Smartsupp account with their status and roles. Use it first to find the agent ids that the write tools need. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/agents.

tools.name: smartsupp_get_agent
tools.description: Get one support agent by id: name, role, status and whether the agent is active. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/agents/{id}.

tools.name: smartsupp_search_conversations
tools.description: Search chat conversations with filters (field, value, op must|must_not|and|or; up to 15), sorting (up to 3 sort keys) and optional full-text search. Returns total, items and the `after` cursor for the next page. Smartsupp API: POST /v2/conversations/search.

tools.name: smartsupp_find_conversation
tools.description: Find a conversation by the external id that your own system stored for it. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/conversations/find?ext_id=.

tools.name: smartsupp_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation: status, assigned agents, tags, rating and contact. Optional extras: messages, internal notes, visitor paths and statistics. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/conversations/{id}.

tools.name: smartsupp_list_conversation_messages
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation, newest first by default, with an `after` cursor for older pages. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/conversations/{id}/messages.

tools.name: smartsupp_find_contact
tools.description: Find a contact (a known customer) by email address. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/contacts/find?email=.

tools.name: smartsupp_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: name, email, phone, properties, tags and notes. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: smartsupp_get_visitor
tools.description: Get one website visitor by id, as stored in Smartsupp. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/visitors/{id}.

tools.name: smartsupp_list_tags
tools.description: List the conversation tags of the account with their ids, names and colors. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/tags.

tools.name: smartsupp_get_statistics
tools.description: Get one chat metric for a date range: response time, first response time, time to close, new or closed conversations, or ratings. Smartsupp API: POST /v2/statistics.

tools.name: smartsupp_get_office_hours
tools.description: Get the office hours settings of the account. Smartsupp API: GET /v2/settings/office-hours.

tools.name: smartsupp_reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Send a text reply from an agent into a conversation. The customer sees the reply when it is sent, so confirm the text first. Smartsupp API: POST /v2/conversations/{id}/messages.

tools.name: smartsupp_add_internal_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a conversation. Only agents see it; the customer does not. It does not assign the conversation or change its status. Smartsupp API: POST /v2/conversations/{id}/notes.

tools.name: smartsupp_assign_conversation
tools.description: Assign a conversation to one agent. Calling it again with the same agent gives the same result. Smartsupp API: PATCH /v2/conversations/{id}/assign.

tools.name: smartsupp_close_conversation
tools.description: Close a conversation. Calling it again on a closed conversation gives the same result. Smartsupp API: PATCH /v2/conversations/{id}/close.

tools.name: smartsupp_tag_conversation
tools.description: Attach an existing tag to a conversation (get the tag id from smartsupp_list_tags). Adding the same tag again changes nothing. Smartsupp API: POST /v2/conversations/{id}/tags.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smartsupp_search_conversations, smartsupp_get_conversation, smartsupp_list_conversation_messages, smartsupp_find_contact, smartsupp_get_contact, smartsupp_get_statistics, smartsupp_tag_conversation · Private data: smartsupp_get_conversation, smartsupp_find_contact, smartsupp_get_contact · Public sink: smartsupp_search_conversations, smartsupp_find_contact, smartsupp_get_contact, smartsupp_get_statistics, smartsupp_reply_to_conversation, smartsupp_add_internal_note, smartsupp_tag_conversation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smartsupp_search_conversations, smartsupp_get_conversation, smartsupp_list_conversation_messages, smartsupp_find_contact, smartsupp_get_contact, smartsupp_get_statistics, smartsupp_tag_conversation · Private data: smartsupp_get_conversation, smartsupp_find_contact, smartsupp_get_contact · Public sink: smartsupp_search_conversations, smartsupp_find_contact, smartsupp_get_contact, smartsupp_get_statistics, smartsupp_reply_to_conversation, smartsupp_add_internal_note, smartsupp_tag_conversation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
